hero.title: Move without the ache you have learned to live with
hero.text: Assessment, hands-on treatment and a plan you can follow at home, from six physiotherapists in one house on Quarry Lane.
hero.text2: Same-week appointments, early mornings and Saturdays.

figures.l: usual wait for a first visit
people at most in a Pilates class

statement.title: We treat the person, then the knee
statement.text: A first visit is forty-five minutes: we listen first, look at how you move, and only then decide what to do. You leave with a written plan and the name of the person who will see you next time.

steps.title: How a first visit goes
steps.text: Four steps, the first three in one hour.

items.title: Tell us what hurts
items.text: When it started, what makes it worse and what you want to get back to.

items.title: We look at how you move
items.text: Walking, bending, lifting: a careful examination, never a rush.

items.title: Treatment the same day
items.text: Hands-on work and the first exercises, shown and tried in the room.

items.title: A plan you can keep
items.text: Written down, with short videos, and checked at your next visit.

features.title: What we treat
features.text: If it is not on the list, ask: we will tell you honestly whether we can help.

items.d: From a stiff morning to a disc that will not settle.
Sprains, strains and the return to play.
Knee and hip replacements, ligament repairs, shoulders.
When the neck is part of the story.
Pelvic pain, the pelvic floor and getting strong again.
Steadier on stairs, at home and outside.
Shins, Achilles and knees, with a look at how you run.
Desk set-up, lifting at work, a plan your employer can read.

catalogue.title: Treatments and prices
catalogue.text: Prices for 2026. Insured patients pay nothing on the day where the insurer allows it.
catalogue.note: Cancel up to 24 hours before at no cost.

items.name: Workstation assessment
items.note: at your office or by video

items.q: Do I need a referral from my doctor?
items.a: No. You can book directly; some insurers ask for one, and we will tell you if yours does.
Something loose you can move in. Shorts for a knee or hip, a vest top for a shoulder.

items.q: How many visits will I need?
items.a: Most people need three to five. We will give you an honest estimate at the first visit.
Six free spaces at the back of the house, reached from Mill Close.
